business_problem: Banking for better, for generations to come"—this mission drives ABN AMRO Bank, a Netherlands-based financial institution committed to vigilance against financial crime. With financial crime on the rise, the bank realized that it needed a new approach to handle its vast transactional data. Embracing technology, it employed Microsoft's Power BI and Azure Synapse Analytics to increase efficiency.
solution_summary: ABN AMRO Bank built this solution on Azure Data Explorer, Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI. Banking for better, for generations to come"—this mission drives ABN AMRO Bank, a Netherlands-based financial institution committed to vigilance against financial crime. Azure Data Explorer stores and queries large volumes of telemetry or transaction data for fast investigation. Azure Synapse Analytics models and analyzes enterprise data for reporting, AI, and decision support. Microsoft Fabric unifies lake, warehouse, and analytics workloads on a governed data foundation. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics to business users. Power BI and Azure Synapse Analytics provided us with the performance for hundreds of concurrent users handling tens of billions of records. It’s enabled us to execute searches much more quickly and more thoroughly.
